notes.title: v1.5.2c Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when opening the Creative block UI on a high resolution display (4k)
[*] Potential fix for a crash that could occur when items are spawned in a multiplayer game.
[*] Fixed issue where game would not run if the log file was inaccessible.
[*] Fix for converting Creative maps not actually using modified terrain.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5.2b Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue preventing controller players from chatting.
[*] Potential fix for floating zombie issue and additional logging.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur if using flying + no clip in creative mode to go under the map.
[*] Fixed zombies not being fully darkened in dark mode.
[*] Detection for swapped primary mouse button added.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a Large HUD option in the Gameplay settings menu.
[*] Added Zambo game modifier for fun crazy defense games.
[*] Added a start time option to city creation.
[*] Added distance to player to the player list UI.
[*] Fixed bug related to dragging blocks onto guns in the inventory.
[*] Fixed bug where removing a container with the screwdriver wouldn't actually remove it.
[*] Fixed a zombie desync that can happen if a zombie is killed far from another player.
[*] Fixed issue where after closing a container it took two key presses to open the same container.
[*] Fix for crash if you have the inventory/container UI up when another player dies in Last Life.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5.1d Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix for zombie health desync after zombies take fall damage.
[*] Fix for zombie health desync after zombies take damage from spikes.
[*] Additional logging related to player health for bug submissions.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.1c Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix for crash on initial load related to having a gun equipped.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5.1b Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix for terrain desync if blocks are added/removed/damaged while player is joining a new game.
[*] Fix for zombie desync issue on spawn that could cause zombies to pop in/out of a location.
[*] Fix for bug that could cause zombies to slowly float away.  It turns out their people did not need them.
[*] Fix for Russo weapons using 5.56mm ammo instead of 7.62x39mm ammo.
[*] Fix for duplicate 5.56mm ammo crafting recipe.
[*] Adding an Ammo category to crafting UI making it easier to find ammo recipes.
[*] Knife secondary animation is now a stab to match game logic.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5.1a Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Clients should get stuck inside zombies less often when playing multiplayer.
[*] Fix for block tooltips not updating properly in the inventory.
[*] Fix for shotguns occasionally causing a block to become bugged on clients.
[*] Fix for game crash if Steam isn't running when game is launched.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Added custom window resizing.
- Reverted change to shadows that might have reduced performance.
- Fix text cursor drawing off into the sunset if you have two lines in the player chat textbox.
- Add hit indicators showing direction the damage is coming from.
- When playing multiplayer games other player's health is now visible on the HUD
- Aiming at players will show their gamertag.
- Crafting list will no longer auto-sort if an item is discovered or no longer craftable.
- Screwdriver secondary will now remove blocks instead of breaking them.
- Screwdriver durability cost for block removal reduced.
- Potential fix for zombie desyncs.
- Fix for crash if a zombie attack wave is spawned near the edge of the map.

notes.title: 1.5.0u Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed crash when starting a game with apocalypse terrain.
- Fix for windowed resolution dropdown not always working properly.
- Fix for resolution dropdown being enabled while in full screen mode (It shouldn't be).

notes.title: v1.5.0t Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for a stutter when playing single player or hosting a game.
- Fix for crash that could occur when starting a game.
- Potential fix for crash that could occur during gameplay.

notes.title: v1.5.0s Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Potential fix for double zombie spawns.
- Improved logging for P2P disconnect errors.
- P2P connections will attempt to restore themselves before quitting a game.
- Potential fix for a black screen stall when connecting to a multiplayer game.
- Fixing typo with 7.62 ammo.
- Fix for crash if quitting the game during load.
- Potential fix for saving crash.
- Additional checks for corrupt object saves and attempted recovery.
- Fix for block renderer crash if you somehow pickup an empty block.

notes.title: v1.5.0q Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Potential fix for save corruption issue, this is a work around that may not resolve all issues.
- Added tracking for city load issues.  UI will now prompt users to submit bugs if a load failure is detected.
- Fix for possible save file corruption.
- Fix for black screen stall when loading into a game with a lot of data to download.

notes.title: v1.5.0p Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for a potential crash when leaving a game.
- Fixed a crash that could occur in RunServerSpawnChange.
- Additional logging for crash with the DefaultBlockRenderer.
- Fixed crash that could occur when an item is spawned on the edge of a player's loaded terrain.
- Fixed crash that could occur when a user first joins a game.
- Player run/walk animations will no longer play when that player is in a menu.

notes.title: 1.5.0o Patch Notes.
notes.content:
- Additional error handling around deleting cities to prevent crashing.
- Additional logging for P2P session failures.
- Enabled P2P packet relay to attempt to address P2P connection issues.

notes.title: 1.5.0n Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for a crash when moving partial stacks from the container to the toolbelt if the toolbelt already has an item present.
- Fix for dupe issue when transferring items into/out of a container.
- Dragging usable items will now stack on the toolbelt when moved from the inventory.

notes.title: v1.5.0m Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for a crash that could occur when placing blocks in creative mode.
- Added limits to the bulk block operations in Creative mode.
- Potential fix for a crash when attempting to action a block.
- Potential fix for a crash when drawing a player not yet fully loaded.
- Fixed issue where the inventory would leak memory.

notes.title: v1.5.0l Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for crash when using the controller to try to join a game when the join list is empty.
- Fix for inventory UI still being present if connection is lost to the game.
- Potential fix for crash on character sound effects

notes.title: 1.5.0k Patch Notes
notes.content: Fix for crash when opening gameplay settings.

notes.title: 1.5.0j Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed issue where items could be dropped between inventory slots.
- Add female hurt/death sounds.  They're a bit scuffed but all I have atm.
- Gun shots will now attract zombies.
- Detection of XNA install crashes and special pop-up to hopefully help people.
- Fixed issue which caused the backup files to be corrupted.
- Remove GPU check code that was not being used.

notes.title: v1.5.0i Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Temporarily removing the 3.5x view distance option as it was causing the game to hit Out of Memory crashes.
- Added keybind textures for mouse side buttons (3 and 4).

notes.title: v1.5.0h Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for potential black screen when connecting to a multiplayer game.


There may be further black screens when joining games.  If you hit them please reach out.

notes.title: v1.5.0g Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fix for crash when breaking a melee item on multiple zombies.
- Potential fix for not being able to see a player in game.
- Adding the option to send contact info for crashes.
- Fixed issue where game would crash if using a controller on an empty city list and using the Start Game keybind.

notes.title: v1.5.0f Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed crash that could occur when player(s) join a multiplayer game.
- Potential fix for crash while saving when leaving the game or respawning.
- Removed tool block target preview when the tool reticle option is disabled, might split this up in the future.
- Fix for crash that can occur when zombies lose their target.
- Fix crash that can occur when pulling items from a crate.
